record.paper_title: Mathematical open problems in Projected Entangled Pair States
record.original_question: Given a finite group G and a normal subgroup H, does there exist a low-depth noisy quantum circuit that maps the quantum double phase associated to G to the quantum double phase associated to H?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G$ be a finite group and $H \trianglelefteq G$ a normal subgroup. For any finite group $K$, let $D(K)$ denote Kitaev's quantum double model associated to $K$, a topologically ordered lattice Hamiltonian whose ground-state space defines the quantum double phase $\mathcal{P}_K$ (with anyonic excitations classified by the representations of the Drinfeld double of $K$).

A noisy quantum circuit of depth $d$ is a composition $\mathcal{C} = \mathcal{L}_d \circ \mathcal{U}_d \circ \cdots \circ \mathcal{L}_1 \circ \mathcal{U}_1$, where each $\mathcal{U}_i$ is a layer of geometrically local unitary gates (each gate acting on a bounded number of qubits) and each $\mathcal{L}_i$ is a layer of local noise channels (e.g., depolarizing channels of fixed strength). A circuit is "low-depth" if $d$ is bounded (independent of system size), or grows at most poly-logarithmically with the system size.

Question: Does there exist a low-depth noisy quantum circuit $\mathcal{C}$ that maps (ground states of) the quantum double phase $\mathcal{P}_G$ to (ground states of) the quantum double phase $\mathcal{P}_H$, thereby implementing the anyon condensation associated with the normal subgroup $H \trianglelefteq G$?
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search did not surface a definitive resolution of this question. Related results exist (e.g., constructions of universal gate sets in $S_3$ quantum doubles, lower bounds showing certain anyon-creation tasks require non-constant unitary depth, and works on anyon condensation in quantum double models with boundaries), but no source clearly establishes (or rules out) the existence of a low-depth noisy circuit implementing the $\mathcal{P}_G \to \mathcal{P}_H$ map for general $G$ and normal $H$. Status appears to remain open in the literature surveyed.

status_evidence.title: A Universal Circuit Set Using the S3 Quantum Double
status_evidence.snippet: Construction of low-depth circuits manipulating S3 quantum double anyons, but does not address general G-to-H condensation circuits.
status_evidence.claim: Related circuit constructions exist for specific groups but do not resolve the general question.

status_evidence.title: The Quantum Double Model with Boundary: Condensations and Symmetries
status_evidence.snippet: Studies anyon condensation in quantum double models via boundaries and domain walls.
status_evidence.claim: Anyon condensation between quantum double phases is studied via boundaries, but circuit-depth realizability is not settled here.

status_evidence.title: Anyon Condensation and the Color Code
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses anyon condensation procedures within topological codes.
status_evidence.claim: Related condensation procedures are studied; general low-depth noisy circuit existence for arbitrary G,H not established.
